europe_now.title: Ratko Mladić Burial in Belgrade
europe_now.summary: Convicted war criminal Ratko Mladić was buried in Belgrade, prompting criticism from the European Union regarding the glorification of war criminals. Thousands gathered for the funeral, which highlights ongoing tensions surrounding regional stability and EU integration.

europe_now.title: Russia Shuts German Consulate Amid Dispute
europe_now.summary: Russia has ordered the closure of a German consulate following an escalating diplomatic dispute over drone incidents. The move reflects deepening friction between Moscow and Berlin amid broader geopolitical tensions.

top_stories.title: German Far-Right Electoral Breakthrough
top_stories.summary: Recent regional elections in Germany have resulted in significant electoral gains for the far-right Alternative for Germany party. Political analysts and minority rights defenders have expressed concern over the broader implications for the nation's political landscape.

top_stories.title: Severe Heatwave Impacts French Wine Harvest
top_stories.summary: Extreme summer weather and scorching temperatures have severely damaged vineyards across France. Consequently, national wine and champagne production figures have dropped dramatically compared to previous years.
